title: NoticeCheck findings (schema 0.1)
description: Procedural defects the taxpayer argued (mistakes by the tax department) and what the High Court decided on each, plus the outcome.

finding.description: defect_found: the court says in its own words the department made this mistake. defect_rejected: the court says it did not, or it is not a valid ground. not_decided: argued but no firm ruling (consent remand, 'one more opportunity', 'contentions kept open', 'prima facie' views, left to appeal, pending in the Supreme Court).

contested.description: true only if this judgment itself notes conflicting High Court views or a pending Supreme Court case on the point

quote.description: court's own words giving the finding; for not_decided with no court words, the argument

remanded.description: true if the matter is sent back to the officer to decide again
